brief:
Israeli occupation authorities issued demolition orders targeting 20 homes in Um Namilah village, also known as Arab Al-Ziadnah, northeast of Rahat city in the Negev region of southern occupied Palestine, Shehab Wire reported. The orders signal imminent displacement of Palestinian families from the community.

The demolition drive comes amid long-standing concerns over systematic efforts to remove Palestinian residents from Negev settlements and expand Israeli control over the territory.
